newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's JSE to work on JET system over weekend.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's JSE to work on JET system over weekend.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) said a full diagnostic analysis will be caried out over the weekend to resolve the problems experienced with its electronic trading system on Friday.
Trade resumed at 1445 GMT and was extended by an hour to 1500 GMT after it was halted for nearly five hours due to network problems on the Johannesburg Equities Trading (JET) system.
"Full diagnostic analysis will be carried out on the network over the weekend to isolate and resolve the problem," JSE president Roy Andersen said in a statement.

He said the problem started at opening when a user experienced network connection difficulties on the system and trading was delayed for five minutes. More problems developed after opening and the system was halted at 0800 GMT.
"The problem was isolated to network hardware and a supplier of network epquipment was called to the JSE to resolve the problem," Andersen said.
He said 4,688 trades took place on Friday, including the one-hour extended session, valued at 281 million rand.
